newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco de Colombia shares pare losses.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Colombia shares pare losses.

text.p: Banco de Colombia stock pared its losses on Colombia's leading exchanges after falling sharply on the announcement earlier today that the bank had abandoned plans to form a strategic partnership with Spain's Banco Central Hispanoamericano.
Traders in Bogota and Medellin said the bank's stock plummeted by about 10 percent to 361 pesos per share before trading was suspended for a 30-minute "cooling off period" early in the session.
But the stock cut its losses soon after trade resumed, ending down just 1.25 percent at 395 pesos per share on both exchanges.
Stock in the bank, Colombia's second largest in terms of assets, has suffered all year from delays in completing the merger with BCH, which was first announced in mid-1996.
